tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Returns how to reach Titan Pest Pro: the phone number, how calls and callbacks work, and the web page for requesting a free inspection. Takes no input.

tools.name: get_trust_facts
tools.description: Returns Titan Pest Pro's published facts about itself: founding year, licence numbers and the licence holder, BBB rating, Google review rating and review counts per market, and the approved wording of its Free Re-Service Guarantee. Every value is the exact published one. Takes no input.

tools.name: explain_free_inspection
tools.description: Explains Titan Pest Pro's free, no-obligation inspection: what happens, what it costs (nothing), which jobs are not free inspections (real-estate WDI/NPMA-33 inspections and dead animal removal), typical scheduling, the arrival call, and how to request one. Takes no input.

tools.description: Lists Titan Pest Pro's own blog posts about pests and pest control, from a checked list (no guest or partner content). tools.name: ask_titan
tools.description: Answers one question about Titan Pest Pro's services, plans, process or policies with the company's approved answer, word for word, from its checked Knowledge Catalog. Read-only. When no approved answer matches, it says so and points to get_contact or request_callback; it never writes a new answer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_service_area, get_contact, get_trust_facts, list_blog_posts · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: list_blog_posts, request_free_inspection, request_callback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_service_area, get_contact, get_trust_facts, list_blog_posts · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: list_blog_posts, request_free_inspection, request_callback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
